verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships a cloud Editor with real-time multi-user editing that vendor docs claim eliminates merge conflicts (playcanvas-docs-4, docs-24/25) and there is a VS Code + Editor API path for local script editing (docs-34), but this is not a diffable/mergeable text-based project format — scenes live in a proprietary cloud store. Community hands-on feedback directly contradicts the version-control-friendliness angle: users report you can't easily use your own source control or work offline, and code must live on PlayCanvas's servers (playcanvas-comm-2, playcanvas-comm-8), with a third-party sync tool needed as a workaround (playcanvas-comm-10). missing for 10: a text-based/diffable scene format, official git integration, and any first-party rebuttal to the community's 'no easy local dev / own source control' complaints.
